Proposition
[bracket as Lie derivative along the flow]

↗ lem:dc-ch0-5-5 ↗ lem:dc-ch0-5-2

1. ch0:5.4Let $X,Y$ be differentiable vector fields on $M$, $p\in M$, and $\varphi _t$ the local flow of $X$ in a neighborhood $U$ of $p$. Then

\[ [X,Y](p)=\lim _{t\to 0}\frac1t\, [Y-d\varphi _t Y](\varphi _t(p)). \]
Proof

\sketch

For $f$ differentiable near $p$, put $h(t,q)=f(\varphi _t(q))-f(q)$; by section 4 there is differentiable $g(t,q)$ with $f\circ \varphi _t(q)=f(q)+tg(t,q)$ and $g(0,q)=Xf(q)$. Then $((d\varphi _t Y)f)(\varphi _t(p))=(Y(f\circ \varphi _t))(p)=Yf(p)+t(Yg(t,p))$, so

\[ \lim _{t\to 0}\frac1t[Y-d\varphi _t Y]f(\varphi _t p)=\lim _{t\to 0}\frac{(Yf)(\varphi _t p)-Yf(p)}{t}-(Yg(0,p))=(X(Yf))(p)-(Y(Xf))(p)=([X,Y]f)(p). \]

□
